ideas.pitch: A static analysis and symbolic execution tool designed to scan custom cryptographic implementations for side-channel vulnerabilities and implementation flaws.
ideas.title: CryoAudit: Automated Cryptographic Primitives Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Cryptography category directly with rigorous, hard engineering (symbolic execution) rather than a wrapper interface, matching the patterns seen in high-tier technical hackathon wins.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined live memory acquisition and analysis tool that automates malicious pattern extraction and process hollowing detection for forensic investigators.
ideas.title: MemForensic: Kernel Memory Dumping and Malware Carving Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on Digital Forensics with deep system-level implementation, appealing directly to CTF judges looking for practical DFIR tooling.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent binary exploitation utility that maps gadget chains, resolves bad characters, and generates reliable Return-Oriented Programming payloads for ELF binaries.
ideas.title: ROPChainGen: Automated ROP Payload Generator for CTF Challenges
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an intensely technical problem (Binary Exploitation) that resonates strongly with a national-level CTF organization and competition judges.

ideas.pitch: A local-first document and credential store utilizing zero-knowledge proofs to authenticate users and manage access without exposing plaintext master keys.
ideas.title: SecGuard: Zero-Knowledge Authenticated Personal Secret Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines web security principles with zero-knowledge cryptography, leveraging the winning formula of heavy cryptographic engineering and exceptional polish.

ideas.pitch: A reverse engineering companion tool that uses local LLMs to rename variables, comment assembly blocks, and flag suspicious control flow graphs in stripped binaries.
ideas.title: DecompileGuard: AI-Assisted Deobfuscation and Reverse Engineering Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles Reverse Engineering with an advanced developer utility workflow, hitting the sweet spot of genuine technical complexity and practical utility.
